subject: mathematics
concept: Reading and writing decimals to one place using place value (tenths)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a decimal value using ten-part on-screen blocks
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a shaded tenths grid and writes the matching decimal
exercise.abstract: Student writes decimals to one place from a spoken/written value

misconception_flags: drops the leading zero (e.g. writes .5 as 5)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
